name: Lud
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The sons of Shem are named: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram, and the sons that came after them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: He will set a sign among them and send those that escape to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, to Tubal and Javan, and to the isles afar off that have not heard his fame nor seen his glory, and they shall declare his glory among the Gentiles.

note.label: Isaiah 66: The Most High's Throne, Zion's Travail, and Judgment by Fire

points: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were her mariners, her wise men were her pilots, and the men of Persia, Lud, and Phut were in her army, hanging their shields and helmets in her to set forth her comeliness.
Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, all the mingled people, and the men of the land that is in league shall fall with them by the sword; those that uphold Egypt shall fall and the pride of her power come down.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
